title: Jeremiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 44
description: Ten questions on Jeremiah 44: the word against the Jews living in Egypt, their refusal to listen, and the queen of the sky.

questions.text: In which land were the Jews living to whom this word came?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 44:1 says the word came concerning all the Jews who lived in the land of Egypt, at Migdol, Tahpanhes, Memphis and in the country of Pathros.

answers.text: In the land of Egypt
In the land of Babylon
In the land of Assyria
In the land of Moab

questions.text: Whom did Yahweh say he had sent to them, rising up early?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says he sent all his servants the prophets, telling them not to do the abominable thing that he hates.

answers.text: All the priests of the temple
The kings of Israel
All his servants the prophets
An army from the north

questions.text: Whose wickedness did Yahweh ask whether they had forgotten?
questions.explanation: Yahweh asks whether they have forgotten the wickedness of their fathers, of the kings of Judah and their wives, and their own wickedness and that of their wives.

answers.text: The wickedness of the nations around them and of their gods
The wickedness of their fathers, of the kings of Judah and of their wives
The wickedness of the priests of Egypt and of their kings
The wickedness of the prophets who were sent to them

questions.text: What did Yahweh say he would set against them, even to cut off all Judah?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says: I will set my face against you for evil, even to cut off all Judah.

answers.text: His covenant of peace
A shepherd to gather them
A sign in the sky
His face, for evil

questions.text: How did Yahweh say the remnant of Judah in Egypt would be consumed?
questions.explanation: The remnant who went to Egypt will all be consumed and will fall there, by the sword and by the famine, from the least even to the greatest.

answers.text: By the sword and by the famine
By flood and by hail
By wild animals and by thirst
By earthquake and by fire

questions.text: How did the people answer Jeremiah about the word he had spoken in Yahweh's name?
questions.explanation: They told Jeremiah that as for the word he had spoken to them in Yahweh's name, they would not listen to him.

answers.text: They said they would obey every word
They said they would ask the elders first
They said they would not listen to him
They said they would return to Judah at once

questions.text: To whom did the people insist on burning incense and pouring out drink offerings?
questions.explanation: They said they would certainly perform every word that had gone out of their mouth, to burn incense to the queen of the sky and pour out drink offerings to her.

answers.text: To Bel of Babylon
To the gods of Assyria
To the sun and the moon
To the queen of the sky

questions.text: What did the people claim they had in the days when they burned incense to the queen of the sky?
questions.explanation: They said that then they had plenty of food, and were well, and saw no evil.

answers.text: Peace with Egypt and with Babylon
Plenty of food, and they were well and saw no evil
Victory in battle over all their enemies
Rain in its season and no sickness among them

questions.text: What did Yahweh swear by his great name about the use of his name in Egypt?
questions.explanation: Yahweh swore that his name would no more be named in the mouth of any man of Judah in all the land of Egypt, saying, As the Lord Yahweh lives.

answers.text: That it would no more be named in the mouth of any man of Judah in Egypt
That it would be praised in every city of Egypt
That he would rebuild Jerusalem within a year
That Egypt would be spared the sword

questions.text: Whom did Yahweh say he would give into the hand of his enemies?
questions.explanation: Yahweh says he will give Pharaoh Hophra king of Egypt into the hand of his enemies and of those who seek his life.

answers.text: Pharaoh Necoh king of Egypt
The king of Assyria
Pharaoh Hophra king of Egypt
The princes of Moab
